When I first read your compositions, those whose verbal brilliance dazzled the eye I regarded as radiant clouds; those that unfolded their splendor and displayed their colors in rich profusion, as auspicious clouds; those that were expansive, powerful, and majestic, pouring forth a thousand li in a single rush, as gathering rainclouds. Those that issued from the utmost harmony, shining far and wide, and were sufficient to lend luster to civil governance, I regarded as felicitous clouds; those that were unhurried, ample, and elegant, with a moist freshness and the countenance of spring, I regarded as…

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
不崇朝而雨是曰泰山之雲
爾多士繼自今以往將搏空
扶搖而上從六龍徧八極驅
策風雷霧雨萬方此余嚮所
謂竊心欣然以爲將雨之徵
也是惟爾多士其或覆日而
爲霧雲積陰而爲霪雲汩沒
===
芬華與時升沉迴翔滅軌而
爲浮雲又其或獵聲實尺
寸靡所自樹覥焉抱三有負
如吾鄉所見西郊之雲甚或
憑藉矯假鼓迅烈以自封殖
爲冰爲雹是謂暴雲茲亦惟
爾多士方今
punctuated: 不崇朝而雨，是曰泰山之雲。爾多士，繼自今以往，將搏空扶搖而上，從六龍，徧八極，驅策風雷，霧雨萬方。此余嚮所謂竊心欣然以爲將雨之徵也，是惟爾多士。其或覆日而爲霧雲，積陰而爲霪雲，汩沒芬華，與時升沉，迴翔滅軌而爲浮雲；又其或獵聲實，尺寸靡所自樹，覥焉抱三有負，如吾鄉所見西郊之雲；甚或憑藉矯假，鼓迅烈以自封殖，爲冰爲雹，是謂暴雲。茲亦惟爾多士。方今
translation_en:
…bringing rain before the morning is over: these are called the clouds of Mount Tai. You assembled scholars, from this time forward, will soar into the sky upon the whirlwind, follow the six dragons, range throughout the eight extremities, command wind and thunder, and spread mist and rain over every region. This is what I meant earlier when I said that inwardly I rejoiced, taking it as a sign of rain to come. This rests with you assembled scholars.
Yet some may obscure the sun and become clouds of fog, or accumulate dark vapors and become clouds of incessant rain; submerging their brilliance, rising and sinking with the times, wheeling about and effacing their tracks, they may become drifting clouds. Others may hunt after reputation and substance [?], yet establish nothing of their own, however small, shamelessly bearing ‘three burdens’ [?], like the clouds I have seen in the western outskirts of my native place. Some may even exploit their connections and make false pretenses, unleashing violent force to enrich themselves, producing ice and hail: these are called violent clouds. This too rests with you assembled scholars. At present…

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
聖天子籍求賢匪徒曰得夫才
而已蓋誠欲得夫若濟大旱
之商霖也〔師説〕以謭陋謬膺
茲典曰惴惴懼不克任亦匪
徒曰得夫才而已蓋誠欲得
夫瓌瑋廊廟之器異日對
大廷聽臚傳五色横空覆蓋使
===
天下後世指其名曰此某所
舉鄉雲士也〔師説〕將有餘榮
焉不爾則將有餘咎焉夫爾
諸士平居所稱述時雨之化
受之于師而習之已者非一
日矣使一出而旋悖焉上無
以仰成
punctuated:
聖天子籍求賢，匪徒曰得夫才而已，蓋誠欲得夫若濟大旱之商霖也。〔師説〕以謭陋謬膺茲典，曰惴惴懼不克任，亦匪徒曰得夫才而已，蓋誠欲得夫瓌瑋廊廟之器，異日對大廷，聽臚傳，五色横空覆蓋，使天下後世指其名曰：「此某所舉鄉雲士也。」〔師説〕將有餘榮焉，不爾則將有餘咎焉。
夫爾諸士，平居所稱述時雨之化，受之于師而習之已者，非一日矣。使一出而旋悖焉，上無以仰成
translation_en:
…The sagely Son of Heaven seeks worthy men through this means [?], not merely to obtain talent, but truly to find men like the rain of Shang that relieved a great drought. I, Shishuo 師説, shallow and ignorant though I am, have undeservedly been entrusted with this examination. Apprehensive [?] and fearful that I cannot discharge this responsibility, I too seek not merely talent, but truly men of exceptional ability fitted for service at court. When, in days to come, they answer before the great court and hear their names proclaimed, may they stretch across the sky in five colors, spreading their shelter, so that all under Heaven and later generations point to their names and say: “These are the cloud-like scholars of the countryside [?] whom so-and-so recommended.” I, Shishuo, will then share in their lasting glory; otherwise, lasting blame will fall upon me.
You scholars have long spoken of the transforming influence of timely rain—the teaching received from your masters and practiced yourselves [?]. This has continued for more than a single day. If, upon first entering public service, you immediately turn against it, you will have no means, above, to fulfill…

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
當寧之懷下有以詒主司者之
人其謂何〔師載〕寡昧不能文
引古昔聊述吾所感以爲二
三子忠告語云以小喻大此
之謂矣爾多士尚其勗諸
河南汝寧府光州固始縣儒
學教諭張〔師載〕謹序
punctuated:
當寧之懷，下有以詒主司者之人，其謂何？〔師載〕寡昧，不能文，引古昔，聊述吾所感，以爲二三子忠告。語云：「以小喻大。」此之謂矣。爾多士尚其勗諸！
河南汝寧府光州固始縣儒學教諭張〔師載〕謹序。
translation_en:
…the hopes of the sovereign on the throne, while bringing reproach upon those who preside over the examination below—what would people say [?]? I, Shizai, am ignorant and unenlightened, with no literary ability. Drawing on antiquity, I have merely set down my thoughts to offer you gentlemen some earnest counsel. As the saying goes, “Use the small to illustrate the great.” This is what it means. May you assembled scholars exert yourselves!
Respectfully composed as a preface by Zhang Shizai, Instructor in the Confucian School of Gushi County, Guang Zhou, Runing Prefecture, Henan.

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
陝西鄉試錄序
我
國家稽古選士之典令天下有
司計三歲大比而賓興焉維
時
今上臨御四載適當其期巡按陝
西監察御史郭〔庭梧〕寔司監
===
臨涖以前巡按御史王〔君賞〕
禮聘四方釁序之秩俾董校
事越八月四日〔魁〕等趨聘至
自四方御史雅注遴才禮遇
殊格〔魁〕等謝弗任滋懼比入
簾乃以〔魁〕暨教諭張〔師載〕司
考試教諭粟〔保民〕李〔奇〕彭〔程〕
punctuated:
陝西鄉試錄序

我國家稽古選士之典，令天下有司計三歲大比而賓興焉。維時今上臨御四載，適當其期。巡按陝西監察御史郭〔庭梧〕寔司監臨。涖以前，巡按御史王〔君賞〕禮聘四方釁序之秩，俾董校事。越八月四日，〔魁〕等趨聘至自四方。御史雅注遴才，禮遇殊格。〔魁〕等謝弗任，滋懼。比入簾，乃以〔魁〕暨教諭張〔師載〕司考試，教諭粟〔保民〕、李〔奇〕、彭〔程〕
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Shaanxi Provincial Examination

Our dynasty, following ancient precedents for selecting men of talent, commands the responsible officials throughout the realm to conduct a great examination every three years and honor those selected with the ceremonial hospitality accorded to worthy men. It was then the fourth year of the present emperor’s reign, and the appointed time had arrived. Guo Tingwu, Investigating Censor serving as Regional Inspector of Shaanxi, was charged with serving as Supervising Official. Before his arrival, Regional Inspector Wang Junshang had courteously invited educational officials [?] from various regions to oversee the examination work.

On the fourth day of the eighth month, we—Kui and the others—arrived from various regions in response to the invitation. The censor was deeply intent on selecting talent and received us with exceptional courtesy. We pleaded our inadequacy and felt all the more apprehensive. When we entered the examiners’ inner quarters, Kui and Zhang Shizai, Instructor, were assigned to serve as Examiners; the Instructors Su Baomin, Li Qi, and Peng Cheng …

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
孟〔齊賢〕謝〔邦泰〕司同考試提
調則左布政使曹〔金〕右參議
中〔佐〕監試則按察副使張一
〔睿〕范〔懋和〕暨百司御事罔不
恪簡以充旣鎖院之夕列炬
焚香盥手籲天肅禮〔魁〕等于
庭而誡之曰惟
===
聖天子寤寐求賢奚啻饑渴惟多
方內外望治需才奚啻雲霓
惟八郡三陲抱藝之士所視
軒輕脫穎奚啻神明厥惟慎
哉已復進大小百司誡之曰
孔子不云乎執事敬惟吾與
爾事在薦賢可無敬乎詩曰
punctuated: 孟〔齊賢〕、謝〔邦泰〕司同考試，提調則左布政使曹〔金〕、右參議中〔佐〕，監試則按察副使張一〔睿〕、范〔懋和〕，暨百司御事，罔不恪簡以充。旣鎖院之夕，列炬焚香，盥手籲天，肅禮〔魁〕等于庭而誡之曰：「惟聖天子寤寐求賢，奚啻饑渴！惟多方內外望治需才，奚啻雲霓！惟八郡三陲抱藝之士，所視軒輕脫穎，奚啻神明！厥惟慎哉！」已復進大小百司，誡之曰：「孔子不云乎：『執事敬。』惟吾與爾，事在薦賢，可無敬乎？詩曰：
translation_en:
…Meng Qixian and Xie Bangtai served as Associate Examiners. The Proctors were Cao Jin, Left Provincial Administration Commissioner, and Zhong Zuo, Right Assistant Administration Commissioner. The examination monitors were Zhang Yirui and Fan Maohe, Surveillance Vice Commissioners. These and all the other officials charged with duties were carefully selected to fill their posts.
On the evening after the examination compound was sealed, torches were set out and incense burned. Having washed his hands and invoked Heaven, he ceremoniously received Kui and the others in the courtyard and admonished them: “The sage Son of Heaven seeks worthy men waking and sleeping, with a longing surpassing hunger and thirst! Throughout the realm, within and beyond the capital, people await good government and need talented men with a longing surpassing that for rain clouds and rainbows! The men of learning from the eight prefectures and three frontier regions look to you to judge their relative merit [?] and enable outstanding talent to emerge, regarding you as more than divine beings! Be most careful!”
He then summoned all the officials, high and low, and admonished them: “Did Confucius not say, ‘Be reverent in carrying out your duties’? Our task, yours and mine, is to recommend worthy men. Can we be without reverence? The Book of Odes says: …

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
夙夜匪懈今日之謂矣尚其
同心哉于時〔魁〕等百司罔不
稽首再拜奉誡惟謹厥明乃
進巡按陜西監察御史潘〔民〕
模今御史劉〔堯卿〕提學副使
徐〔善慶〕前後所取士二千有
奇三試之矢心甄别得士六
十五人錄其姓名及文之純
===
者以
獻〔魁〕以職事當敘諸首簡因僭
言曰維茲關陜古雍州也河
嶽孕靈是生英儁故世稱豪
傑輒首三秦厥惟舊哉因憶
往爲諸生間嘗披閱圖經夢
punctuated:
「夙夜匪懈」，今日之謂矣。尚其同心哉！」于時，〔魁〕等百司罔不稽首再拜，奉誡惟謹。厥明，乃進巡按陜西監察御史潘〔民〕模、今御史劉〔堯卿〕、提學副使徐〔善慶〕前後所取士二千有奇，三試之，矢心甄别，得士六十五人。錄其姓名及文之純者以獻。
〔魁〕以職事當敘諸首簡，因僭言曰：維茲關陜，古雍州也。河嶽孕靈，是生英儁，故世稱豪傑，輒首三秦，厥惟舊哉！因憶往爲諸生間，嘗披閱圖經，夢
translation_en:
…“Never slackening, morning or night”—these words speak of this very day. May you all act with one heart!” At this, Kui and all the other officials bowed their heads to the ground and bowed twice, receiving the admonition with utmost reverence. The following morning, they admitted the more than two thousand candidates selected successively by Pan Minmo, Investigating Censor touring Shaanxi; Liu Yaoqing, the present Censor; and Xu Shanqing, Education Intendant and Surveillance Vice Commissioner. They examined them in three sessions and, pledging themselves to conscientious discrimination, selected sixty-five men. They recorded their names and the finest of their compositions for presentation to the throne.
Kui, whose official duties required him to write the prefatory account at the beginning of the record, thereupon ventured to say: This region of Guanzhong and Shaanxi was ancient Yongzhou. Its rivers and mountains nurture spiritual potency, giving birth to outstanding men. Thus, when people speak of heroes, they invariably place the Three Qin regions first. How longstanding this tradition is! I recall that, when I was a government student, I once pored over illustrated gazetteers and dreamed…

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
寐秦隴思欲泛洪河闚巨靈
陟二華盱秦嶺一慰遡洄仰
止之願無從也迺今服官黌
校應聘而來始涉于河達于
渭已而歷潼關踰華陰至止
長安時秋水方盛澎湃淪漣
仰瞻華嶽終南出沒雲漢曰
===
美哉山河此天下之奇觀也
昔人所稱隩區不其然哉豪
傑者將在是乎既而偕諸同
事入棘院縱觀多士之文其
立言雖殊類皆明於經術之
故察於性命之微通於時務
之變其氣昌而不肆其志遠
punctuated: 寐秦隴，思欲泛洪河，闚巨靈，陟二華，盱秦嶺，一慰遡洄仰止之願，無從也。迺今服官黌校，應聘而來，始涉于河，達于渭，已而歷潼關，踰華陰，至止長安。時秋水方盛，澎湃淪漣，仰瞻華嶽、終南，出沒雲漢，曰：「美哉山河！此天下之奇觀也。昔人所稱隩區，不其然哉！豪傑者將在是乎？」既而偕諸同事入棘院，縱觀多士之文，其立言雖殊，類皆明於經術之故，察於性命之微，通於時務之變。其氣昌而不肆，其志遠，
translation_en:
…dreamed of Qin and Long, wishing to sail upon the mighty Yellow River, glimpse the Giant Spirit, ascend the two Hua mountains, and gaze upon the Qinling range, thereby satisfying my longing to journey there and behold what I revered; yet I had no means of doing so. Now, serving in the schools, I came in response to an invitation. First I crossed the Yellow River and reached the Wei River; then I passed through Tongguan, traversed Huayin, and arrived at Chang’an. At that time the autumn waters were in full spate, surging and rippling. Looking up, I beheld Mount Hua and Zhongnan appearing and disappearing among the clouds in the heavens, and said: “How beautiful these mountains and rivers are! This is a wondrous spectacle under Heaven. Is this not indeed the sheltered region praised by men of old? Surely outstanding men are to be found here!”
Thereafter, I entered the examination compound with my colleagues and surveyed the candidates’ writings. Although their formulations differed, they were generally clear in their understanding of the principles of classical learning, discerning about the subtleties of human nature and destiny, and conversant with the changing demands of contemporary affairs. Their spirit was vigorous without being unrestrained, and their aspirations far-reaching…

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
而不迂其辭達而不支美而
非夸質而不俚咸可以儕于
作者之塗而鳴我
國家之盛焉因語諸同事者曰
於戲休哉此西土之善鳴者
也昔人所云嶽降非虛語哉
豪傑者非其人耶唯我
===
國家二百年于玆菁莪棫樸之
化達於天下漸漬淪浹曁我
聖天子御極文敎維新黎獻共臣
薄於海外翙翙岐豐之舊猶
有聖王之遺化者宜彬彬翼
翼若是乎其盛也抑余于多
士尤有所忠告焉昔傳稱雍
punctuated: 而不迂，其辭達而不支，美而非夸，質而不俚，咸可以儕于作者之塗，而鳴我國家之盛焉。因語諸同事者曰：「於戲，休哉！此西土之善鳴者也。昔人所云嶽降，非虛語哉！豪傑者非其人耶？唯我國家二百年于玆，菁莪棫樸之化達於天下，漸漬淪浹。曁我聖天子御極，文敎維新，黎獻共臣，薄於海外。翙翙岐豐之舊，猶有聖王之遺化者，宜彬彬翼翼若是乎其盛也！抑余于多士尤有所忠告焉。昔傳稱雍
translation_en:
…yet not impractical. Their diction is expressive without being rambling, elegant without being extravagant, plain without being vulgar. All may take their place among accomplished writers and give voice to the flourishing of our dynasty. Accordingly, I said to my colleagues: “Ah, how admirable! These are the fine voices of the western lands. What the ancients said about the sacred peaks sending down great men was surely no empty saying! Are these not those outstanding men?

“Our dynasty has now endured for two hundred years. Its transforming influence, nurturing talent as celebrated in ‘Luxuriant Southernwood’ (Jing e) and ‘Oak and Scrub’ (Yu pu), has reached throughout the realm, gradually permeating it in full. Since our sage Son of Heaven ascended the throne, literary instruction has been renewed; the worthy among the people all serve as his subjects, and this influence extends beyond the seas. In the ancient lands of Qi and Feng, where phoenix wings once rustled, the transforming legacy of the sage kings still survives. How fitting that such refinement and reverent diligence should flourish here!

“Yet I have some especially earnest counsel for these many scholars. An ancient account says that Yong…

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
州土厚水深其民厚重質直
無驕惰浮靡之習凡民猶然
矧士人哉故其士人皆果敢
剛毅無巽懦輭美之風是以
其文亦皆卓犖雄偉無骫骳
萎薾之氣異日者祇奉
大對布列庶司當必有忠藎之
士不二心之臣出于其閒以
===
仰副
聖主側席之求以共成輯寧之治
也已迺或忘其先資虧厥素
履顧自諉曰謀適不用也人
將訾之矣尚得謂之秦有人
哉主司者何以逭其罪也聞
punctuated: 州土厚水深，其民厚重質直，無驕惰浮靡之習。凡民猶然，矧士人哉！故其士人皆果敢剛毅，無巽懦輭美之風。是以其文亦皆卓犖雄偉，無骫骳萎薾之氣。異日者，祇奉大對，布列庶司，當必有忠藎之士、不二心之臣出于其閒，以仰副聖主側席之求，以共成輯寧之治也已。迺或忘其先資，虧厥素履，顧自諉曰：「謀適不用也。」人將訾之矣，尚得謂之秦有人哉？主司者何以逭其罪也？聞
translation_en:
…the region has deep soil and deep waters; its people are earnest, steady, unaffected, and upright, without habits of arrogance, indolence, frivolity, or extravagance. If even the common people are so, how much more its scholars! Thus its scholars are all resolute and courageous, firm and steadfast, free of timidity, weakness, and ingratiating softness. Their writings, accordingly, are outstanding and magnificent, without any air of contrivance or feebleness. In days to come, when they reverently present their answers at the Palace Examination and take their places in the various offices, there will surely emerge among them men of devoted loyalty and ministers of undivided allegiance, who will fulfill our sage sovereign’s eager search for worthy men and together bring about peaceful and harmonious government.
Yet if any should forget their original endowments and compromise their accustomed conduct, merely excusing themselves by saying, “My proposals simply were not adopted,” people will reproach them. Could it still be said that Qin has worthy men? How could those presiding over the examination escape blame? I have heard…

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
之周人以玉爲璞宋人以腊
爲朴周人聞宋人有璞也禮
而索觀之宋人藏之什襲已
而出之乃腊也周人掩口而
笑今多士爲腊乎爲玉乎無
使主司若宋人然俾周人之
掩口也多士幸相與毖之是
===
舉也總督軍務前右都御史
兼兵部右侍郎王〔崇古〕今右
都御史兼兵部左侍郎王〔之〕
誥相繼彈猷靖域綏厥士類
巡撫陜西右副都御史張〔師〕
載保釐底績文敎以興屬條
代𡚁行今右副都御史楊〔思〕
punctuated:
之：周人以玉爲璞，宋人以腊爲朴。周人聞宋人有璞也，禮而索觀之。宋人藏之什襲，已而出之，乃腊也。周人掩口而笑。今多士爲腊乎？爲玉乎？無使主司若宋人然，俾周人之掩口也。多士幸相與毖之。
是舉也，總督軍務前右都御史兼兵部右侍郎王〔崇古〕、今右都御史兼兵部左侍郎王〔之〕誥，相繼彈猷靖域，綏厥士類。巡撫陜西右副都御史張〔師〕載，保釐底績，文敎以興。屬條代𡚁行，今右副都御史楊〔思〕
translation_en:
…this account: the people of Zhou called unworked jade pu; the people of Song called dried meat pu. A man of Zhou, hearing that a man of Song possessed some pu, politely asked to see it. The man of Song had stored it wrapped in ten layers; when he finally brought it out, it was dried meat. The man of Zhou covered his mouth and laughed. Now, are you candidates dried meat, or are you jade? Do not let the presiding examiners be like that man of Song, causing the man of Zhou to cover his mouth in laughter. May you candidates take heed together.
For this examination, the successive supreme commanders of military affairs—Wang Chonggu, formerly Right Censor-in-Chief and concurrently Right Vice Minister of War, and Wang Zhigao, the present Right Censor-in-Chief and concurrently Left Vice Minister of War—have exerted themselves in planning, pacified the region, and fostered its scholars. Zhang Shizai, Grand Coordinator of Shaanxi and Right Vice Censor-in-Chief, achieved results in preserving order and administering the region, thereby promoting literary education. Upon a change of tenure and departure [?], the present Right Vice Censor-in-Chief, Yang Si…

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
忠〔〕
風猷丕著士心夙嚮巡撫
右僉都御史延綏李〔尚智〕今
何〔東序〕寧夏沈〔應時〕甘肅王
輪〔〕撫治鄖陽汪〔道昆〕相與屛
翳中外雅重文教監察御史
茶馬楊〔相〕河東鹽法郜〔永春〕
稽餉蕭〔廩〕洪敷風紀士習丕
===
振兵科左給事中楊〔一魁〕戶
部郎中張〔體乾〕王〔基〕趙〔大倫〕
中書舍人孫〔惟清〕行人司左
司副唐〔文燦〕有事茲土嘉樂
敷惠左參政溫〔如春〕右參政
于〔錦〕梁〔明翰〕馮〔舜漁〕楊〔衍慶〕
左參議沈〔人种〕右參議楊〔樞〕
punctuated: 忠〔〕，風猷丕著，士心夙嚮。巡撫右僉都御史延綏李〔尚智〕、今何〔東序〕，寧夏沈〔應時〕，甘肅王輪〔〕，撫治鄖陽汪〔道昆〕，相與屛翳中外，雅重文教。監察御史茶馬楊〔相〕、河東鹽法郜〔永春〕、稽餉蕭〔廩〕，洪敷風紀，士習丕振。兵科左給事中楊〔一魁〕、戶部郎中張〔體乾〕、王〔基〕、趙〔大倫〕、中書舍人孫〔惟清〕、行人司左司副唐〔文燦〕，有事茲土，嘉樂敷惠。左參政溫〔如春〕、右參政于〔錦〕、梁〔明翰〕、馮〔舜漁〕、楊〔衍慶〕、左參議沈〔人种〕、右參議楊〔樞〕
translation_en:
…[Yang Si]zhong’s exemplary conduct and achievements are conspicuous, and the scholars have long looked up to him. The Grand Coordinators holding the title of Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief—Li Shangzhi of Yansui and the present incumbent, He Dongxu; Shen Yingshi of Ningxia; and Wang Lun of Gansu—together with Wang Daokun, responsible for pacification and administration in Yunyang, have jointly provided protection within and without [?] and have consistently esteemed literary education. The Investigating Censors Yang Xiang, responsible for tea and horses; Gao Yongchun, responsible for the Hedong salt administration; and Xiao Lin, responsible for auditing military provisions, have broadly upheld discipline, greatly invigorating the conduct of scholars.

Yang Yikui, Left Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for War; Zhang Tiqian, Wang Ji, and Zhao Dalun, Bureau Directors in the Ministry of Revenue; Sun Weiqing, Secretariat Drafter; and Tang Wencan, Left Vice Director of the Messenger Office, have carried out duties in this region and gladly extended their beneficence. Wen Ruchun, Left Administration Vice Commissioner; Yu Jin, Liang Minghan, Feng Shunyu, and Yang Yanqing, Right Administration Vice Commissioners; Shen Renzhong, Left Administration Assistant Commissioner; and Yang Shu, Right Administration Assistant Commissioner…

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
副使祁〔天敘〕張〔守中〕劉〔應時〕
張〔志孝〕楊〔栢〕僉事栗〔魁周〕馬
〔文健〕都司署都指揮僉事張
〔一正〕詹〔恩〕皆綜理防範協恭
于外右布政使楊〔守魯〕按察
使王〔元春〕趨事始至樂觀厥
成行太僕寺卿周〔京〕許〔東望〕
===
少卿劉〔時舉〕苑馬寺卿侯〔東
萊〕少卿黃〔襄〕同事一方法得
書
山東兗州府東平州儒學學
正高〔魁〕謹序
punctuated:
副使祁〔天敘〕、張〔守中〕、劉〔應時〕、張〔志孝〕、楊〔栢〕，僉事栗〔魁周〕、馬〔文健〕，都司署都指揮僉事張〔一正〕、詹〔恩〕，皆綜理防範，協恭于外。右布政使楊〔守魯〕、按察使王〔元春〕，趨事始至，樂觀厥成。行太僕寺卿周〔京〕、許〔東望〕，少卿劉〔時舉〕，苑馬寺卿侯〔東萊〕，少卿黃〔襄〕，同事一方，法得書。
山東兗州府東平州儒學學正高〔魁〕謹序。
translation_en:
…The Surveillance Vice Commissioners Qi Tianxu, Zhang Shouzhong, Liu Yingshi, Zhang Zhixiao, and Yang Bai; the Surveillance Assistant Commissioners Li Kuizhou and Ma Wenjian; and Zhang Yizheng and Zhan En, acting Assistant Regional Military Commissioners in the Regional Military Commission, all coordinated precautions and cooperated respectfully in duties outside the examination compound. Right Provincial Administration Commissioner Yang Shoulu and Surveillance Commissioner Wang Yuanchun had only just arrived to take up their duties and were pleased to witness its successful completion. Zhou Jing and Xu Dongwang, Ministers of the Branch Court of the Imperial Stud; Liu Shiju, Vice Minister of that court; Hou Donglai, Minister of the Court of Imperial Horse Pasturages; and Huang Xiang, Vice Minister of that court, served together in this region and thus may, by convention, be recorded here.
Preface respectfully composed by Gao Kui, School Director of the Confucian School of Dongping Subprefecture, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong.

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
隆慶四年陝西鄉試
監臨官
巡按陝西監察御史郭庭梧〔子材河南新鄉縣人　乙丑進士〕
提調官
陝西等處承宣布政使司左布政使曹　金〔汝礪河南祥符縣人　丁未進士〕
陝西等處承宣布政使司右參議申　佐〔懋良直隸永年縣人　丙辰進士〕
監試官
陝西等處提刑按察司副使張一齊〔天光河南睢陽衛人　丙辰進士〕
陝西等處提刑按察司副使范懋和〔中吾四川富順縣人　丙辰進士〕
===
考試官
山東兗州府東平州儒學學正高　魁〔文選直隸寧國府宣城縣人　乙卯貢士〕
河南汝寧府光州固始縣儒學教諭張師載〔志銘湖廣江陵縣人　戊午貢士〕
同考試官
河南歸德府夏邑縣儒學教諭粟保民〔以德四川巴縣人乙　卯貢士〕
河南汝州魯山縣儒學教諭李　奇〔正伯四川巴縣人　子貢士〕
山西太原府太谷縣儒學教諭彭　程〔天翼河南淮縣人戊　午貢士〕
直隸順德府唐山縣儒學教諭孟齊賢〔師聖浙江錢塘縣人　乙卯貢士〕
直隸真定府井陘縣儒學教諭謝邦泰〔道亨福建邵武縣人　丁卯貢士〕
punctuated:
隆慶四年陝西鄉試

監臨官

translation_en:
Shaanxi Provincial Examination, Fourth Year of Longqing (1570)

Supervising Official
Guo Tingwu, Investigating Censor serving as Regional Inspector of Shaanxi. His courtesy name was Zicai; he was from Xinxiang County, Henan, and became a metropolitan graduate (jinshi) in the yichou year.

Proctors
Cao Jin, Left Provincial Administration Commissioner in the Shaanxi Provincial Administration Commission. His courtesy name was Ruli; he was from Xiangfu County, Henan, and became a metropolitan graduate in the dingwei year.
Shen Zuo, Right Assistant Administration Commissioner in the Shaanxi Provincial Administration Commission. His courtesy name was Maoliang; he was from Yongnian County, Zhili, and became a metropolitan graduate in the bingchen year.

Examination Monitors
Zhang Yiqi, Vice Commissioner in the Shaanxi Provincial Surveillance Commission. His courtesy name was Tianguang; he was from Suiyang Guard, Henan, and became a metropolitan graduate in the bingchen year.
Fan Maohe, Vice Commissioner in the Shaanxi Provincial Surveillance Commission. His courtesy name was Zhongwu; he was from Fushun County, Sichuan, and became a metropolitan graduate in the bingchen year.

Examiners
Gao Kui, Instructor in the Confucian School of Dongping Subprefecture, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong. His courtesy name was Wenxuan; he was from Xuancheng County, Ningguo Prefecture, Zhili, and became a tribute student (gongshi) in the yimao year.
Zhang Shizai, Instructor in the Confucian School of Gushi County, Guang Subprefecture, Runing Prefecture, Henan. His courtesy name was Zhiming; he was from Jiangling County, Huguang, and became a tribute student in the wuwu year.

Associate Examiners
Su Baomin, Instructor in the Confucian School of Xiayi County, Guide Prefecture, Henan. His courtesy name was Yide; he was from Ba County, Sichuan, and became a tribute student in the yimao year.
Li Qi, Instructor in the Confucian School of Lushan County, Ru Subprefecture, Henan. His courtesy name was Zhengbo; he was from Ba County, Sichuan, and became a tribute student in a zi year [?, the cyclical date is incomplete].
Peng Cheng, Instructor in the Confucian School of Taigu County, Taiyuan Prefecture, Shanxi. His courtesy name was Tianyi; he was from Huai County [?], Henan, and became a tribute student in the wuwu year.
Meng Qixian, Instructor in the Confucian School of Tangshan County, Shunde Prefecture, Zhili. His courtesy name was Shisheng; he was from Qiantang County, Zhejiang, and became a tribute student in the yimao year.
Xie Bangtai, Instructor in the Confucian School of Jingxing County, Zhending Prefecture, Zhili. His courtesy name was Daoheng; he was from Shaowu County, Fujian, and became a tribute student in the dingmao year.

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
第壹塲
四書
樊遲問仁子曰愛人問知子曰知人
唯天下至聖爲能聰明睿知足以有臨也
其爲氣也至大至剛以直養而無害則塞
于天地之間其爲氣也配義與道無是
餒也是集義所生者非義襲而取之也
行有不慊於心則餒矣我故曰告子未
嘗知義以其外之也必有事焉而勿正
心勿忘勿助長也
===
易
內陽而外陰內健而外順內君子而外小
人
當位以節中正以通
夫易廣矣大矣以言乎遠則不禦以言乎
邇則靜而正以言乎天地之間則備矣
夫乾其靜也專其動也直是以大生焉
夫坤其靜也翕其動也闢是以廣生焉
punctuated:
第壹塲

四書

樊遲問仁，子曰：「愛人。」問知，子曰：「知人。」

唯天下至聖，爲能聰明睿知，足以有臨也。

其爲氣也，至大至剛，以直養而無害，則塞于天地之間。其爲氣也，配義與道；無是，餒也。是集義所生者，非義襲而取之也。行有不慊於心，則餒矣。我故曰：「告子未嘗知義，以其外之也。」必有事焉而勿正，心勿忘，勿助長也。

易

內陽而外陰，內健而外順，內君子而外小人。

當位以節，中正以通。

夫易，廣矣，大矣！以言乎遠，則不禦；以言乎邇，則靜而正；以言乎天地之間，則備矣。夫乾，其靜也專，其動也直，是以大生焉。夫坤，其靜也翕，其動也闢，是以廣生焉。
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

Fan Chi asked about benevolence. The Master said, “Love others.” He asked about wisdom. The Master said, “Know others.”

Only the most sagely person in the world possesses the acuity of hearing and sight, profound understanding, and wisdom sufficient to preside over others.

As vital force (qi), it is supremely great and supremely firm. If nourished with uprightness and left unharmed, it fills the space between Heaven and Earth. As vital force, it accords with righteousness and the Way; without these, it starves. It is produced by the accumulation of righteous deeds, not acquired through an isolated act of righteousness. If one's conduct leaves the heart dissatisfied, it starves. Thus I said, “Gaozi has never understood righteousness, because he regards it as external.” One must constantly work at it without anticipating the outcome; the heart must neither forget it nor try to force its growth.

Book of Changes

Yang is within and yin without; strength is within and compliance without; noble men are within and petty men without.

Occupying the proper position, one exercises restraint; through centrality and correctness, one achieves free passage.

How broad and great the Changes are! Speaking of what is distant, they are without bounds; speaking of what is near, they are still and correct; speaking of what lies between Heaven and Earth, they encompass it all. Qian, in stillness, is concentrated; in movement, it is direct. Thus it brings forth greatness. Kun, in stillness, is gathered in; in movement, it opens out. Thus it brings forth breadth. …

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
廣大配天地變通配四時陰陽之義配
日月易簡之善配至德
黃帝堯舜垂衣裳而天下治
書
后克艱厥后臣克艱厥臣政乃乂黎民敏
德帝曰俞允若兹嘉言罔攸伏野無遺
賢萬邦咸寧
厥土惟黃壤厥田惟上上
嚴恭寅畏天命自度
===
穆穆在上明明在下灼于四方
詩
鳲鳩在桑其子在棘淑人君子其儀不忒
其儀不忒正是四國
豈敢定居一月三捷
思皇多士生此王國王國克生維周之楨
敬之敬之天維顯思命不易哉無曰高高
在上陟降厥士日監在兹維予小子不
聰敬止日就月將學有緝熙于光明佛
punctuated:
廣大配天地，變通配四時，陰陽之義配日月，易簡之善配至德。
黃帝、堯、舜垂衣裳而天下治。

書
后克艱厥后，臣克艱厥臣，政乃乂，黎民敏德。帝曰：「俞！允若兹，嘉言罔攸伏，野無遺賢，萬邦咸寧。」
厥土惟黃壤，厥田惟上上。
嚴恭寅畏，天命自度。
穆穆在上，明明在下，灼于四方。

詩
鳲鳩在桑，其子在棘。淑人君子，其儀不忒。其儀不忒，正是四國。
豈敢定居？一月三捷。
思皇多士，生此王國。王國克生，維周之楨。
敬之敬之！天維顯思，命不易哉！無曰高高在上，陟降厥士，日監在兹。維予小子，不聰敬止。日就月將，學有緝熙于光明。佛
translation_en:
… Its breadth and greatness match Heaven and Earth; its changes and adaptations match the four seasons; the significance of yin and yang matches the sun and moon; and the goodness of ease and simplicity matches the highest virtue.
The Yellow Emperor, Yao, and Shun let their upper and lower garments hang down, and all under Heaven was well governed.

Book of Documents
If the ruler recognizes the difficulty of being a ruler, and ministers recognize the difficulty of being ministers, government will be well ordered, and the common people will strive diligently for virtue. The emperor said: “Yes! If it is truly so, no worthy counsel will remain hidden, no worthy man will be left undiscovered in the countryside, and the myriad states will all be at peace.”
Its soil is yellow loam; its fields are of the highest grade.
With solemn reverence and watchful awe, he measured himself against Heaven’s mandate.
Majestic was he above; enlightened were those below; their brilliance shone throughout the four quarters.

Book of Odes
The cuckoo is in the mulberry tree; its young are in the thorn bushes. The good and noble man is faultless in his deportment. Faultless in his deportment, he sets right the states of the four quarters.
How could we dare settle down in repose? In one month we won three victories.
Ah, the many splendid men born in this royal kingdom! The royal kingdom can bring them forth: they are the pillars of Zhou.
Be reverent, be reverent! Heaven is indeed manifest; its mandate is not easy to retain! Do not say that it is high, high above: it ascends and descends here [?], daily watching over this place. I, the young one, lack understanding of reverence. Advancing day by day and progressing month by month, through learning I shall attain ever greater brightness. Assist …

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
時仔肩示我顯德行
春秋
春鄭人來輸平〔隱公六年〕
春王正月公會齊侯宋公陳侯衛侯鄭伯
許男曹伯侵蔡蔡潰遂伐楚次于陘
楚屈完來盟于師盟于召陵〔俱僖公四〕
〔年〕冬公會晉侯宋公衛侯曹伯莒子邾
子滕子薛伯杞伯小邾子齊世子光伐
鄭十有二月已亥同盟于戲〔襄公九年〕
===
冬十有二月祭伯來〔隱公元年〕春王正月
公會王人齊侯宋公衛侯許男曹伯陳
世子款盟于洮〔僖公八年〕楚子蔡侯次
于厥貉〔文公十年〕六月公會宋公陳侯
衛侯鄭伯許男曹伯晉趙盾癸酉同盟
于新城〔文公十有四年〕
公會晉侯及吳子於黃池〔哀公十有三年〕
禮記
忠信禮之本也義理禮之文也
punctuated:
時仔肩，示我顯德行。

春秋
春，鄭人來輸平。〔隱公六年〕
春，王正月，公會齊侯、宋公、陳侯、衛侯、鄭伯、許男、曹伯侵蔡，蔡潰，遂伐楚，次于陘。楚屈完來盟于師，盟于召陵。〔俱僖公四〕〔年〕冬，公會晉侯、宋公、衛侯、曹伯、莒子、邾子、滕子、薛伯、杞伯、小邾子、齊世子光伐鄭。十有二月，已亥，同盟于戲。〔襄公九年〕
冬，十有二月，祭伯來。〔隱公元年〕春，王正月，公會王人、齊侯、宋公、衛侯、許男、曹伯、陳世子款盟于洮。〔僖公八年〕楚子、蔡侯次于厥貉。〔文公十年〕六月，公會宋公、陳侯、衛侯、鄭伯、許男、曹伯、晉趙盾，癸酉，同盟于新城。〔文公十有四年〕
公會晉侯及吳子於黃池。〔哀公十有三年〕

禮記
忠信，禮之本也；義理，禮之文也。
translation_en:
…in bearing this burden, show me illustrious virtue and conduct.

Spring and Autumn Annals

In spring, men of Zheng came to conclude peace. 〔Sixth year of Duke Yin〕

In spring, in the first month of the royal calendar, the Duke joined the Marquis of Qi, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Chen, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Zheng, the Baron of Xu, and the Earl of Cao in invading Cai. Cai collapsed. They then attacked Chu and encamped at Xing. Qu Wan of Chu came to make a covenant with the army; they concluded the covenant at Shaoling. 〔Both entries: fourth year of Duke Xi〕

In winter, the Duke joined the Marquis of Jin, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Cao, the Viscount of Ju, the Viscount of Zhu, the Viscount of Teng, the Earl of Xue, the Earl of Qi, the Viscount of Little Zhu, and Guang, heir apparent of Qi, in attacking Zheng. In the twelfth month, on the jihai day [?], they jointly concluded a covenant at Xi. 〔Ninth year of Duke Xiang〕

In winter, in the twelfth month, the Earl of Zhai came. 〔First year of Duke Yin〕

In spring, in the first month of the royal calendar, the Duke met the king’s representative, the Marquis of Qi, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Wei, the Baron of Xu, the Earl of Cao, and Kuan, heir apparent of Chen, to conclude a covenant at Tao. 〔Eighth year of Duke Xi〕

The Viscount of Chu and the Marquis of Cai encamped at Juehe. 〔Tenth year of Duke Wen〕

In the sixth month, the Duke met the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Chen, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Zheng, the Baron of Xu, the Earl of Cao, and Zhao Dun of Jin. On the guiyou day, they jointly concluded a covenant at Xincheng. 〔Fourteenth year of Duke Wen〕

The Duke met the Marquis of Jin and the Viscount of Wu at Huangchi. 〔Thirteenth year of Duke Ai〕

Book of Rites

Loyalty and trustworthiness are the foundation of ritual; righteousness and principle are its patterned expression.

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
春作夏長仁也秋斂冬藏義也仁近於樂
義近於禮
天子者與天地參故德配天地兼利萬物
與日月並明明照四海而不遺微小其
在朝廷則道仁聖禮義之序燕處則聽
雅頌之音行步則有環佩之聲升車則
有鸞和之音居處有禮進退有度百官
得其宜萬事得其序
先勞而後祿不亦易祿乎
===
第貳場
論
爲政貴有以來天下之善
詔誥表〔内科一道〕
擬漢令州郡舉茂才異等可爲將相詔〔元封五年〕
擬唐加左僕射房玄齡太子少師誥〔貞觀十三年〕
擬
punctuated:
春作夏長，仁也；秋斂冬藏，義也。仁近於樂，義近於禮。

天子者，與天地參，故德配天地，兼利萬物，與日月並明，明照四海而不遺微小。其在朝廷，則道仁聖禮義之序；燕處，則聽雅頌之音；行步，則有環佩之聲；升車，則有鸞和之音。居處有禮，進退有度，百官得其宜，萬事得其序。

先勞而後祿，不亦易祿乎？

第貳場

論
爲政貴有以來天下之善。

詔誥表〔内科一道〕
擬漢令州郡舉茂才異等可爲將相詔〔元封五年〕。
擬唐加左僕射房玄齡太子少師誥〔貞觀十三年〕。
擬
translation_en:
Growth in spring and flourishing in summer are benevolence; gathering in autumn and storing in winter are righteousness. Benevolence is close to music; righteousness is close to ritual.

The Son of Heaven forms a triad with Heaven and Earth. Thus his virtue matches Heaven and Earth, benefiting all things alike. His brilliance equals that of the sun and moon, illuminating the Four Seas without overlooking even the smallest things. At court, he follows the ordered principles of benevolence, sagacity, ritual, and righteousness. At leisure, he listens to the sounds of the Odes and Hymns. When he walks, his jade pendants sound; when he mounts his carriage, its bells chime. His conduct accords with ritual, and his advances and withdrawals observe due measure. The hundred officials each find their proper place, and all affairs attain their proper order.

If service comes first and emolument afterward, does this not make emolument easy to receive?

Second Session

Discourse
In governing, what matters is having the means to attract all the goodness under Heaven.

Edicts, Proclamations of Investiture, and Memorials 〔One topic from among these [?].〕
Compose an edict in the voice of a Han emperor ordering the provinces and commanderies to recommend men of outstanding and exceptional talent capable of serving as generals or chief ministers. 〔Fifth year of Yuanfeng.〕
Compose a Tang proclamation conferring on Fang Xuanling, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, the additional title of Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent. 〔Thirteenth year of Zhenguan.〕
Compose …

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
三殿工成
欽定名額頒示中外廷臣
賀表〔嘉靖四十一年〕

第叄塲
策〔五道〕
問古者嗣服守文之主所以撫成業而致
盛治者其道非一也然詩書所載則于
敬天法祖三致意焉豈二者守成之要
與粤若夏商代有令主而説者何獨以
成王爲首稱與載觀周公戒成王曰無
念爾祖曰永言配命是矣乃其所自爲
佐武王觀兵開創不知於文王以服事
punctuated:

第叄塲
策〔五道〕
問：古者嗣服守文之主，所以撫成業而致盛治者，其道非一也。然詩書所載，則于敬天法祖三致意焉。豈二者守成之要與？粤若夏商，代有令主，而説者何獨以成王爲首稱與？載觀周公戒成王，曰「無念爾祖」，曰「永言配命」，是矣。乃其所自爲，佐武王觀兵開創，不知於文王以服事
translation_en:
…a congratulatory memorial from the court officials on the completion of the three palace halls, whose names were imperially determined and promulgated at court and throughout the realm. 〔Forty-first year of Jiajing〕

Legal judgments 〔Five items〕
An official exceeds the time limit for taking up his appointment.
Household status is to be determined by registration.
Prohibiting the illicit arts of spirit mediums.
Frontier authorities submit requests for military supplies.
Repairing bridges and roads.

Third Session
Policy questions 〔Five questions〕
Question: In antiquity, rulers who inherited the throne and upheld established institutions had more than one way of preserving their inherited achievements and bringing about flourishing government. Yet the records in the Book of Odes and the Book of Documents repeatedly emphasize revering Heaven and emulating one’s ancestors. Are these two things, then, the essentials of preserving an inherited achievement? The Xia and Shang dynasties each had worthy rulers; why do commentators single out King Cheng for foremost praise? Consider further the Duke of Zhou’s admonitions to King Cheng: “Never fail to remember your ancestor” and “Forever accord with the Mandate.” These were indeed right. Yet in his own actions he assisted King Wu in displaying his military forces and founding a new dynasty. I wonder how this compares with King Wen’s serving…

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
殷昭事上帝得無異與抑創守果二道
與及孔子論武周則又槩以達孝稱之
抑又何與歷漢唐宋英君誼辟非無克
盡其道者彼其崇泰畤守斜封何又以
爲不足敬且法與至如宋臣有謂人君
若不畏天何事不可爲者有謂祖宗法
度不可廢者又有謂天不足畏祖不足
法者果孰爲正與我
太祖高皇帝肇造區夏開天統人上謹明畏下
===
垂法守
存心有錄
昭鑒有錄可爲萬世不易之法程矣我
成祖文皇帝誕膺鴻運以其所以欽若
憲章者著爲
聖學心法
文華寶鑑曁我
世宗肅皇帝纘承丕基
欽天有頌
punctuated: 殷、昭事上帝，得無異與？抑創守果二道與？及孔子論武、周，則又槩以達孝稱之，抑又何與？歷漢、唐、宋，英君誼辟非無克盡其道者，彼其崇泰畤、守斜封，何又以爲不足敬且法與？至如宋臣，有謂人君若不畏天，何事不可爲者；有謂祖宗法度不可廢者；又有謂天不足畏、祖不足法者，果孰爲正與？我太祖高皇帝肇造區夏，開天統人，上謹明畏，下垂法守。存心有錄，昭鑒有錄，可爲萬世不易之法程矣。我成祖文皇帝誕膺鴻運，以其所以欽若、憲章者，著爲《聖學心法》、《文華寶鑑》。曁我世宗肅皇帝纘承丕基，欽天有頌，
translation_en:
…Yin and illustriously serving the Lord on High: was there perhaps a difference? Or are founding a dynasty and preserving it indeed two different ways? Yet when Confucius discussed King Wu and the Duke of Zhou, he praised both for their consummate filial piety. Why was this? Throughout the Han, Tang, and Song dynasties, there were certainly enlightened rulers and righteous sovereigns capable of fully realizing this way. Why, then, are their exaltation of the Tai Altar and retention of appointments issued under slanting seals deemed inadequate expressions of reverence for Heaven and emulation of the ancestors? As for ministers of the Song, one said that if a ruler did not fear Heaven, what might he not do? Another said that the laws and institutions of the ancestors must not be abandoned. Yet another said that Heaven need not be feared and the ancestors need not be emulated. Which view is truly correct?

Our Emperor Taizu Gao founded his rule over the Chinese realm, inaugurated Heaven’s mandate, and united the people under his rule. Above, he was scrupulous in showing enlightened reverence; below, he bequeathed standards to be observed. There was a Record of Preserving the Mind (Cunxin lu), and a Record of the Luminous Mirror (Zhaojian lu), which could serve as unchanging standards for ten thousand generations. Our Emperor Chengzu Wen received the great mandate, setting forth the principles by which he reverently followed Heaven and took ancestral precedents as his model in Essential Methods of Sagely Learning (Shengxue xinfa) and Precious Mirror of Literary Splendor (Wenhua baojian). Then our Emperor Shizong Su succeeded to the vast imperial foundation; for revering Heaven, there was a hymn…

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
敬一有箴
祖德有詩謌
陵有述固宛乎三聖相授受一道也可得而揄
揚其萬一與我
皇上踐祚以來
郊廟必躬必親於諸臣章奏動求
祖宗舊制所謂嚴恭寅畏作求世德者亦旣至
矣而頻年災祲屢聞治效未臻豈圖治
之道抑有進于敬
===
天法
祖之外與子諸士抱致君之猷求試于有司願
畢所藴以爲
聖天子新德之助云
問天地之道易知簡能古未有文也自儒
者各抒所見以立言而道始紛然多岐
矣由今攷之易曰河出圖洛出書聖人
則之謂伏羲則之以畫八卦神禹則之
以敘九章似也而或謂則龍馬爲圖非
punctuated:
敬一有箴，祖德有詩，謌陵有述，固宛乎三聖相授受一道也。可得而揄揚其萬一與？我皇上踐祚以來，郊廟必躬必親，於諸臣章奏動求祖宗舊制，所謂嚴恭寅畏、作求世德者，亦旣至矣。而頻年災祲屢聞，治效未臻，豈圖治之道抑有進于敬天法祖之外與？子諸士抱致君之猷，求試于有司，願畢所藴，以爲聖天子新德之助云。

問：天地之道，易知簡能，古未有文也。自儒者各抒所見以立言，而道始紛然多岐矣。由今攷之，《易》曰：「河出圖，洛出書，聖人則之。」謂伏羲則之以畫八卦，神禹則之以敘九章，似也。而或謂則龍馬爲圖，非
translation_en:
…On reverence for the One, there is an admonition; on ancestral virtue, there are poems; on the imperial mausoleums [?], there is an account. Surely these clearly embody a single Way transmitted from one sage emperor to another through three reigns. Can you extol even a ten-thousandth part of it? Since Our Emperor ascended the throne, he has invariably performed the suburban and ancestral-temple sacrifices in person. In considering his ministers’ memorials, he constantly seeks the established institutions of his ancestors. What is called solemn reverence and vigilant awe, and the striving to carry forward the virtue of preceding generations, has indeed reached its utmost expression. Yet reports of calamities and baleful portents have repeatedly arrived over successive years, and the desired results of government have not been attained. Could the way to achieve good government involve something further, beyond revering Heaven and emulating the ancestors? You scholars cherish plans for guiding your ruler and seek examination by the responsible officials. We hope you will set forth all that you have within you, to assist the sagely Son of Heaven in renewing his virtue.

Question: The Way of Heaven and Earth is easy to know and simple in its capacity to accomplish things; in antiquity there were as yet no writings. Only after Confucian scholars each expressed their own views in written statements did the Way become confused amid a multitude of divergent paths. Examining the matter today, we find that the Book of Changes says: “The Yellow River brought forth the Chart, and the Luo River brought forth the Writing; the sages took them as models.” It seems plausible to say that Fuxi took the former as his model in drawing the Eight Trigrams, and that the divine Yu took the latter as his model in setting out the nine divisions. Yet some say that the dragon-horse was taken as a model to make a chart, not …

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
為卦則洛龜為書非為疇果何所見與
有謂十為河圖九為洛書似也而或謂
九為河圖十為洛書抑何所據與有謂
河圖為體洛書為用者體用不一源與
有謂河圖主常洛書主變者常變果二
道與又有謂河圖天道而洛書人道河
圖天道無心而洛書聖人有憂然與否
與同一造化也河圖以相生順布于五
位而洛書以相制逆施于八方同一象
===
數也河圖之數五十有五而洛書之數
四十有五其旨可得而聞與易本自河
圖何以為周孔之易其義則洛書疇本
自洛書何以為洪範之用不出于河圖
此皆道統所由傳治道所攸繫者不可
以無辨也子諸士研理待問久矣竊願
有聞焉
問人才之盛衰古稱氣運之隆替世道之
治忽繫焉信斯言也運隆化洽宜莫如
punctuated:
為卦，則洛龜為書，非為疇，果何所見與？有謂十為河圖、九為洛書，似也，而或謂九為河圖、十為洛書，抑何所據與？有謂河圖為體、洛書為用者，體用不一源與？有謂河圖主常、洛書主變者，常變果二道與？又有謂河圖天道而洛書人道，河圖天道無心而洛書聖人有憂，然與否與？同一造化也，河圖以相生順布于五位，而洛書以相制逆施于八方；同一象數也，河圖之數五十有五，而洛書之數四十有五，其旨可得而聞與？易本自河圖，何以為周孔之易，其義則洛書？疇本自洛書，何以為洪範之用，不出于河圖？此皆道統所由傳、治道所攸繫者，不可以無辨也。子諸士研理待問久矣，竊願有聞焉。
問：人才之盛衰，古稱氣運之隆替、世道之治忽繫焉。信斯言也，運隆化洽，宜莫如
translation_en:
…making the trigrams, and that taking the Luo River turtle as the Writing did not mean making the categories: what insight actually underlies this view? The claim that ten belongs to the River Chart and nine to the Luo Writing seems plausible; yet some say that nine belongs to the River Chart and ten to the Luo Writing. On what grounds? Some hold that the River Chart is substance and the Luo Writing is function. Do substance and function not have a single source? Some hold that the River Chart governs constancy and the Luo Writing governs change. Are constancy and change really two distinct Ways? Others say that the River Chart concerns the Way of Heaven and the Luo Writing the human Way—that in the River Chart the Way of Heaven acts without conscious intent, whereas in the Luo Writing the sage is beset by concern. Is this so or not? Both embody the same creative transformations, yet the River Chart distributes the five phases among five positions in the forward sequence of mutual generation, while the Luo Writing deploys them in eight directions in the reverse sequence of mutual restraint. Both embody the same images and numbers, yet the numbers of the River Chart total fifty-five, while those of the Luo Writing total forty-five. May we hear the meaning of this? The Changes originated in the River Chart; why, then, does the Changes of the Duke of Zhou and Confucius take its meaning from the Luo Writing? The categories originated in the Luo Writing; why, then, does the application of the Great Plan remain within the River Chart? These are all matters through which the transmission of the Way proceeds and upon which the Way of government depends. They must be carefully distinguished. You gentlemen have long investigated principles in readiness for questioning. I humbly hope to hear your views.
Question: Regarding the flourishing and decline of men of talent, the ancients said that the rise and fall of the cosmic cycles, and order and disorder in the world, depend upon them. If these words are true, then for flourishing fortune and the pervasive influence of moral transformation, surely nothing could equal …

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
唐虞三代之初而于稽其才則舜五人
武王十人何若是少耶乃孔子稱才難
則又獨以爲盛焉何耶且阿衡以匹夫
興湯而三仁不能以存殷亦有三治保
衛三傑啓漢而人龍不足以延劉治忽
果無關于人才之多寡耶謂養之貴豫
矣而巖穴肇中興之業垂綸啓清明之
化養之果何校也謂求之貴廣矣而岳
牧之諮視辟舉制科之所取廣狹有間
===
而才不加多抑又何耶我
聖祖奮起淮甸除殲伐暴王師所向豪傑景從
一時翊
運佐命元勳方之舜武可得而歷數其盛與
我
皇上嗣守洪圖勵精化理辟德行舉遺佚虛心
求才奚啻饑渴而又數
詔內外臣工各舉所知可謂望治之極矣屬者
南北多事疆場未靖司銓者將愼簡以
punctuated: 唐虞三代之初，而于稽其才，則舜五人，武王十人，何若是少耶？乃孔子稱才難，則又獨以爲盛焉，何耶？且阿衡以匹夫興湯，而三仁不能以存殷；亦有三治保衛，三傑啓漢，而人龍不足以延劉，治忽果無關于人才之多寡耶？謂養之貴豫矣，而巖穴肇中興之業，垂綸啓清明之化，養之果何校也？謂求之貴廣矣，而岳牧之諮，視辟舉制科之所取，廣狹有間，而才不加多，抑又何耶？我聖祖奮起淮甸，除殲伐暴，王師所向，豪傑景從。一時翊運佐命元勳，方之舜武，可得而歷數其盛與？我皇上嗣守洪圖，勵精化理，辟德行，舉遺佚，虛心求才，奚啻饑渴！而又數詔內外臣工，各舉所知，可謂望治之極矣。屬者南北多事，疆場未靖，司銓者將愼簡以
translation_en:
…the beginnings of the ages of Tang Yao and Yu Shun and of the Three Dynasties. Yet when we examine their men of talent, Shun had five and King Wu ten. Why were they so few? Confucius spoke of the difficulty of finding talent, yet singled out this period as flourishing in talent. Why?

Moreover, the Aheng, Yi Yin, rose from commoner status to bring Tang to power, whereas the three humane men could not preserve Yin. There were also the three who governed and preserved Wei [?], and the Three Heroes who founded the Han; yet the dragon among men could not prolong the rule of the Liu house. Does good government or disorder truly bear no relation to the number of talented men? It is said that talent must be nurtured beforehand; yet a recluse from a rocky cave initiated a dynastic restoration, and a man fishing with his line inaugurated enlightened government. What effect, then, did nurturing talent actually have? It is said that the search for talent must be broad; yet consultation with the chiefs of the regions and provincial governors differed in breadth from recruitment through summons, recommendation, and special examinations, without the latter yielding more talented men. Why was this so?

Our Sagely Progenitor rose in the Huai region, eliminated enemies [?], and attacked the violent. Wherever the royal armies advanced, heroes followed like shadows. Can we enumerate the abundance of founding ministers of outstanding merit who then assisted the rise of his rule and aided his receipt of Heaven’s mandate, comparing them with those of Shun and King Wu?

Our Emperor has inherited and preserved the grand imperial enterprise, applying himself diligently to transformative government. He summons men of virtuous conduct and recommends worthy men who have been overlooked. His open-minded search for talent exceeds even hunger and thirst! Moreover, he has repeatedly commanded officials at court and in the provinces each to recommend those they know. This may indeed be called the utmost aspiration to good government. Recently, troubles have multiplied in both north and south, and the frontiers remain unsettled. Those responsible for official selection will choose carefully in order to…

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
國家究而臨事有乏才之嘆其故何耶諸士
子夙以古才賢自期待繼自今將服寀
有位其何所施措以比隆唐虞三代之
盛惟勿諱勿讓
問理財之道其來遠矣考之周禮所載理
其財之出而已而國不見其不足乃後
世理其財之入隨事立法而國用恒歉
焉此其故何與無論三代以上即在叔
世有患年饑用不足者而或告以薄稅
===
斂有賀租賦歲倍者而辭以爲反裘負
薪果足國之道有不在于厚征與亦有
歲蠲田租之半已而罷除十年者一時
號稱殷富其後言利之臣筭無遺利乃
不免爲虛耗豈賦斂之厚薄無關于財
用之充詘與嗣是以還有多方進者而
國用愈困有上會計錄者而撙節未聞
抑又何與我
國家稽古定制田有定賦賦有常法可謂纖
punctuated:
國家究，而臨事有乏才之嘆，其故何耶？諸士子夙以古才賢自期待，繼自今將服寀有位，其何所施措，以比隆唐虞三代之盛？惟勿諱勿讓。

問：理財之道，其來遠矣。考之《周禮》所載，理其財之出而已，而國不見其不足。乃後世理其財之入，隨事立法，而國用恒歉焉，此其故何與？無論三代以上，即在叔世，有患年饑用不足者，而或告以薄稅斂；有賀租賦歲倍者，而辭以爲反裘負薪。果足國之道，有不在于厚征與？亦有歲蠲田租之半，已而罷除十年者，一時號稱殷富，其後言利之臣筭無遺利，乃不免爲虛耗。豈賦斂之厚薄，無關于財用之充詘與？嗣是以還，有多方進者，而國用愈困；有上《會計錄》者，而撙節未聞，抑又何與？我國家稽古定制，田有定賦，賦有常法，可謂纖
translation_en:
…for the state [?], yet when affairs must be handled, there are laments over the lack of capable men. Why is this? You candidates have long aspired to equal the talented and worthy men of antiquity. Hereafter you will enter official service and hold office. What measures will you undertake to match the flourishing rule of Tang Yao, Yu Shun, and the Three Dynasties? Speak without concealment or undue modesty.

Question: The art of managing finances has a long history. Examining what is recorded in the Rites of Zhou, we find that they merely regulated expenditure, yet the state suffered no shortage. In later ages, however, they regulated revenue, devising laws as circumstances arose, yet state funds were constantly insufficient. Why was this? Leaving aside the Three Dynasties and earlier times, even in ages of decline, when someone worried that famine had left resources insufficient, he might be advised to reduce taxation. When someone was congratulated on doubling annual tax receipts, he rejected the congratulations, likening this to carrying firewood while wearing a fur coat inside out. Can it really be that the way to enrich the state does not lie in heavy taxation? There was also a ruler who remitted half the land tax annually and subsequently abolished it for ten years; his age was celebrated for its prosperity. Later, ministers intent on revenue calculated every possible source of gain, yet depletion could not be avoided. Can the weight of taxation have no bearing on the sufficiency or insufficiency of financial resources? In subsequent times, some brought in revenue by many means, yet state finances became still more strained. Others submitted Records of Financial Accounting, yet nothing was heard of economies being achieved. Why, again, was this? Our dynasty consulted antiquity to establish its institutions: land bears fixed taxes, and taxation follows established rules. These may be said, down to the smallest detail…

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
悉具備公私兼利矣嗣我
皇上登極之初
崇儉恤民罷不急之役停採辦之科
詔下所司有曰天下軍民十分窮困國用雖詘
豈忍照常徵派有曰朕加意節省用自有餘
除民今歲田租十之五踰年
建儲禮成又
詔賜民田租十之三至哉
王心古堯舜禹湯文武之仁天下不啻過也何
頃歲郡國空虛邊鎮饋餉所需大司農
===
每告匱焉至
請下廷臣條上封事稾爲理財集議一書檄行
中外覆議以
聞者夫事窮則變變則通不知當何如而後可
以爲足國足民之策也爾諸生雅抱經
國之猷願明以告我
問方今天下之務可言者多矣其最重且
急者莫先於備邊而備邊之道莫要於
punctuated:
悉具備，公私兼利矣。嗣我皇上登極之初，崇儉恤民，罷不急之役，停採辦之科。詔下所司，有曰：「天下軍民十分窮困，國用雖詘，豈忍照常徵派？」有曰：「朕加意節省，用自有餘。」除民今歲田租十之五。踰年，建儲禮成，又詔賜民田租十之三。至哉，王心！古堯舜禹湯文武之仁天下，不啻過也。何頃歲郡國空虛，邊鎮饋餉所需，大司農每告匱焉？至請下廷臣條上封事，稾爲《理財集議》一書，檄行中外，覆議以聞者。夫事窮則變，變則通，不知當何如而後可以爲足國足民之策也？爾諸生雅抱經國之猷，願明以告我。

問：方今天下之務，可言者多矣。其最重且急者，莫先於備邊；而備邊之道，莫要於
translation_en:
…fully provided for in every detail, benefiting both the public and private alike. Then, at the beginning of our Emperor’s reign, he upheld frugality and showed solicitude for the people, abolished nonessential labor services, and suspended procurement levies. An edict issued to the responsible offices stated: “The soldiers and civilians throughout the realm are in utter distress. Though state funds are insufficient, how could I bear to impose levies and assessments as usual?” It also stated: “If I take particular care to economize, there will naturally be enough for expenditure.” He remitted five-tenths of the people’s land tax for that year. The following year, upon completion of the ceremonies establishing the heir apparent, he again decreed a remission of three-tenths of the people’s land tax. How consummate is the sovereign’s heart! His benevolence toward all under Heaven more than surpasses that of the ancient rulers Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Wen, and Wu. Why, then, have the prefectures and territories lately been depleted, while the Minister of Revenue repeatedly reports insufficient funds for the provisions and pay required by the frontier garrisons? Matters have reached the point of a request that court officials be instructed to submit itemized sealed memorials, which were compiled into a book entitled Collected Deliberations on Managing State Finances (Licai jiyi), circulated by official dispatch to the capital and the provinces for further deliberation and reporting to the throne. When affairs reach an impasse, change follows; through change, a way opens. What, then, must be done to devise a policy that will provide adequately for both the state and the people? You students have long cherished plans for ordering the realm; I hope you will explain them clearly to me.

Question: Among the affairs of the realm today, many could be discussed. Of those most important and urgent, none takes precedence over frontier defense; and among the means of defending the frontier, none is more essential than …

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
兵將二者古今言任將制兵之法載在
往籍亡暇論已先是玁狁匪茹憑陵我
城郭虔劉我人民秉樞者有憂焉請
詔下中外臣工各陳所爲禦戎之策其論將有
曰求之貴廣任之貴專儲之貴豫是矣
乃今選之世冑出之因縶拔之行伍辟
之武科不可謂不廣也與之生殺貸之
小過以血戰爲功而不以損傷爲罪不
可謂不專也自襲廕之士以至於廢閑
之錄列之將牒需次而拜不可謂不豫
也其論兵有曰養之貴優選之貴精練
之貴熟是矣乃今屯粒之外繼之民運
又繼之
===
內帑養之不已厚乎汰其老稚補其逋亡惟
其人不惟其數選之不已精乎操習有
期敎演有法
聖天子大閱以振作于上憲臣分閱以激勵于
外練之不已熟乎如此者固宜將識士
punctuated: 兵將二者。古今言任將制兵之法，載在往籍，亡暇論已。先是，玁狁匪茹，憑陵我城郭，虔劉我人民。秉樞者有憂焉，請詔下中外臣工，各陳所爲禦戎之策。其論將，有曰：「求之貴廣，任之貴專，儲之貴豫。」是矣。乃今選之世冑，出之因縶，拔之行伍，辟之武科，不可謂不廣也；與之生殺，貸之小過，以血戰爲功，而不以損傷爲罪，不可謂不專也；自襲廕之士，以至於廢閑之錄，列之將牒，需次而拜，不可謂不豫也。其論兵，有曰：「養之貴優，選之貴精，練之貴熟。」是矣。乃今屯粒之外，繼之民運，又繼之內帑，養之不已厚乎？汰其老稚，補其逋亡，惟其人，不惟其數，選之不已精乎？操習有期，敎演有法，聖天子大閱以振作于上，憲臣分閱以激勵于外，練之不已熟乎？如此者，固宜將識士
translation_en:
…troops and commanders. The methods discussed throughout the ages for appointing commanders and organizing troops are recorded in earlier writings; there is no leisure to discuss them here. Previously, the Xianyun, devoid of restraint, assailed our cities and slaughtered our people. Those directing military affairs were troubled by this and requested an edict instructing officials at court and in the provinces each to present proposals for repelling the invaders. Regarding commanders, some said: “In seeking them, breadth is essential; in entrusting them with responsibility, undivided authority is essential; in keeping them in reserve, advance preparation is essential.” This is correct. Now commanders are selected from hereditary military families, brought out of confinement [?], promoted from the ranks, and recruited through the military examinations: the search can hardly be called narrow. They are granted authority over life and death and pardoned for minor faults; bloody fighting is counted as merit, while casualties are not treated as an offense: their authority can hardly be called divided. From men enjoying hereditary succession or privilege to those on the registers of dismissed or inactive officers, they are entered on the rolls of commanders and appointed when their turn comes: this can hardly be called a lack of advance preparation.

Regarding troops, some said: “In maintaining them, generous provision is essential; in selecting them, discrimination is essential; in training them, thorough proficiency is essential.” This is correct. Now, beyond grain from military agricultural colonies, supplies are supplemented by grain transported by the populace, and further supplemented by the imperial treasury: is their maintenance not already generous? The old and the immature are discharged, and deserters and the deceased are replaced; attention is paid to the men themselves, not merely their numbers: is their selection not already discriminating? Drills have fixed schedules, and instruction and exercises follow established methods. The sagely Son of Heaven holds a grand review to rouse them from above, while censorial officials conduct separate reviews to encourage them in the provinces: is their training not already thorough? Under such conditions, commanders surely ought to understand their soldiers…

title: 隆慶四年陝西鄉試錄
text:
情士識將意昔人所謂如身之使臂臂
之使指以戰則克以守則固可也夫何
頻年以來醜虜內侮長驅深入而兵將
迄無成功其故可得而聞與抑任將制
兵之法或有出于羣議所未及與其在
陝西四鎮雖連歲烽燧稍寧而徹桑土
以爲陰雨之備不可以不講也諸士生
長密邇邊陲籌之稔矣盍詳著于篇以
觀爾經濟之藴
punctuated: 情，士識將意，昔人所謂「如身之使臂，臂之使指」，以戰則克，以守則固，可也。夫何頻年以來，醜虜內侮，長驅深入，而兵將迄無成功，其故可得而聞與？抑任將制兵之法，或有出于羣議所未及與？其在陝西四鎮，雖連歲烽燧稍寧，而徹桑土以爲陰雨之備，不可以不講也。諸士生長密邇邊陲，籌之稔矣，盍詳著于篇，以觀爾經濟之藴？
translation_en: …the feelings of their soldiers, and the soldiers understand their commanders’ intentions. As the ancients put it, “like the body directing the arm, and the arm directing the fingers,” they should then be victorious in battle and secure in defense. Why, then, have the vile northern foes, year after year, invaded our territory and driven deep within it, while our soldiers and commanders have achieved no success? May we hear the reasons? Or might there be methods of appointing commanders and directing troops that have escaped public deliberation? As for the four frontier garrisons of Shaanxi, although the beacon alarms have been somewhat quieter for several successive years, we must still discuss preparations against future trouble, like gathering mulberry roots to secure a nest before the rains. You candidates grew up close to the frontier and have surely considered these matters thoroughly. Why not set out your views in detail in your essays, so that we may see the depth of your capacity for ordering the realm and aiding its people?
